messages:
jamie: Heads-up — we need final signoff on the private/VPC airgap bundle for customer-42. Packaging target tonight 00:00 UTC. Can we confirm manifest pinning, cosign sigs, and rollback hooks?
lia: Working through manifest pinning now. I pushed a draft submanifest to s3://redwood-private/releases/cust42/199990. Will attach checksums in a sec.
deploy-bot: deploy window automatically scheduled for 1999904000 (00:00 UTC). Canary nodes: 2 of 20. Auto-rollback on >=5% error rate within 10m.
sanjeev: For rollback we should prefer the previous signed bundle (1999897000). Plan: 1) Switch DNS to canary backend 2) Revert image pins in manifest 3) Re-deploy. Need KMS access to re-sign if we republish.
maria: Cosign sigs are here: cosign://signed/release-199990. I verified with `cosign verify --key ksm://projects/redwood/keys/release-key release.tar.gz` — good. Also verified sha256: `sha256sum release.tar.gz` => `3f2a1b...d9`.
lia: Adding the sha map to the submanifest: `images: {gpu-server: sha256:3f2a1b..., installer: sha256:7c9e4f...}`. Uploaded a gzipped manifest: s3://redwood-private/releases/cust42/199990/submanifest.json.gz
ops-bot: NOTE: airgap delivery will run from 00:00–02:00 UTC. Network ops approved 02:00–03:00 rollback window. Please keep public comms minimal until after 03:30 UTC.
alex: Release notes draft in GH: https://github.com/redwood/release-notes/pull/214 — includes upgrade path + known issue about KV cache warmup. Please add any customer-facing rollback instructions.
jamie: @maria can you grab the KMS policy for the sign key and ensure the onprem ops team has decrypt-only for verification? We don't want interactive re-signing in the middle of night.
maria: Confirmed — decrypt-only token for ops-team created. Token TTL 4 hours. Stored in vault path `secret/redwood/cust42/signing-token`. ops-team can run `cosign verify` but not `cosign sign` with that token.
sanjeev: One more ask: add a smoke test step post-delivery that hits `/healthz` and runs a small generation (~32 tokens) against pinned model v1.9.2-quant. Fails -> auto-fallback to CPU-early path and alert.
lia: Added smoke tests to packaging script. Snippet: ```bash
# smoke test
curl -sS https://127.0.0.1:8443/healthz || exit 1
python3 -c "import requests; r=requests.post('https://127.0.0.1:8443/generate', json={'prompt':'test','max_tokens':32}); assert r.status_code==200"
```
deploy-bot: Canary deploy initiated at 1999904000. Monitoring metrics: latency, 5xx, token cost delta. Will post summary at +15m and +60m.
alex: Also bump the private-installer version in notes to 1.12.0+cust42 and include the checksum and cosign link.
jamie: OK — if canary looks green at +60m we proceed full rollout. If errors spike, rollback to 1999897000 and notify legal + CS. Everyone on standby 23:30–03:30 UTC. :thumbsup:
lia: Uploaded final artifacts and manifest. Link: s3://redwood-private/releases/cust42/199990/final/
jamie: thanks — I’ll watch the first checks.
ops-bot: Reminder: run the post-delivery report command once complete: `./tools/reporting/post_delivery_report --release 199990 --customer cust42`
jamie: Closing thread for now — will reopen if any failures. Good luck tonight! :rocket:
